aboutUs.title: Our History & Mission
aboutUs.description1: At Masis Garden, we believe that bringing nature indoors enriches lives and transforms spaces. Based in the heart of Yerevan, Armenia, our mission is to provide premium quality indoor plants, handcrafted pots, and stunning moss art to our community.
aboutUs.description2: Whether you are a seasoned plant parent or just starting your green journey, we are here to support you with expert advice and carefully curated selections.
aboutUs.description3: Every plant in our collection is hand-inspected for optimal vitality, potted in nutrient-dense soil, and paired with custom artisanal pottery designed to bring living beauty into every room.
aboutUs.journeyText: Founded in Yerevan, Masis Garden grew from a passion for botanical aesthetics, air purification, and sustainable urban greenery for homes and offices.
aboutUs.b2bText: Bulk plant supply & direct imports from Iran to Armenia for shops, online stores & gardens.
aboutUs.mossText: Expert care tips, watering guides & decoration ideas from our botanical specialists.

wholesale.title: Plant Wholesale & Bulk Import
wholesale.subtitle: Specialized B2B plant supply & bulk freight logistics from Iran to Armenia. We partner with plant shops, online boutiques, garden centers, and landscape designers to provide premium acclimatized indoor greenery at wholesale rates.
wholesale.pricingText: Special wholesale rates & bulk discount tiers tailored for flower shops and commercial resellers across Armenia.
wholesale.freightText: Direct, climate-controlled bulk transport straight from top Persian nurseries to Armenia with phytosanitary clearance.
wholesale.stockText: Healthy, hand-inspected indoor plants fully acclimatized to local environments, guaranteed fresh and ready for resale.

footer.tagline: Bringing greenery to every Armenian home.
